best_idea: The server does not simulate: it validates each client batch by message type and unit ownership, relays only the valid messages, and appends the non-empty ones to an ordered replay log that a late joiner receives in full.
decision_why: Keep the intake gate (type whitelist, unit-to-owner check, invalid dropped and never relayed) and the ordered replay log; reject raw relay of engine batches to clients because Frankendom's server is the only authority.
acceptance: A server test sends a hit for a character the sending client does not own and asserts it is dropped (not broadcast, not logged); a second test replays the fight log to a late joiner and asserts the same final HP for every character.
